entities.name: Henri Streicher
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Henri Streicher was a French Catholic archbishop who served as Vicar Apostolic of Northern Victoria Nyanza from 1897 to 1933. He ordained the continent's first Catholic priests of modern times, both from Uganda.
